integrity: The all-sample-size result follows from exact sampling-without-replacement moments through order four. Exhaustive finite enumeration is supplementary and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes two independent samples from one common continuous distribution and Anderson's Cramér–von Mises normalization.
The full text of Pettitt (1979), a particularly relevant component-decomposition paper, could not be inspected because the publisher required human verification; this is a residual originality risk.
The result gives an exact covariance, not a complete joint distribution or independence statement.
title: Exact finite null coupling of Mann–Whitney and two-sample Cramér–von Mises
